title: Jin Tae‑Kyung trapped in a game after a faulty logout
caption:
He finally sees the *exit* button… but it vanishes! 😱

Part 1. Follow for Part 2!

#loginmurim #manhwa #manhwarecap #manga #recap #fyp
comment: What will Jin do when the system refuses to let him leave? 🤔

segments.say: Jin stares at the flashing *exit* button on the screen
He taps it, hoping the game *finally* logs him out
The button flickers, then *disappears* entirely
A cold voice echoes, *"You cannot leave now"*
Jin’s heart races as the room around him *glitches*
He looks down, *realizing* his hands are pixelated
The VR console hums louder, lights pulsing like a *heartbeat*
A message pops up: *"SYSTEM LOCKED"*
Jin tries the manual again, *desperate* for a solution
The manual’s warning blinks: *"PLAYER WILL NOT BE ABLE TO LOG OUT"*
He *remembers* the tutorial quest that never ended
The tutorial voice taunts, *"WELCOME, MASTER JIN"*
Jin’s mind *flashes* to his low‑rank hunter life
He *recalls* being fired and his family’s shame
His mother’s voice in his memory urges him to *survive*
He hears his *sister*’s laugh, now just static noise
Jin clenches his fists, *determined* to fight this code
He opens the *inventory*, searching for any weapon
A *keenspear* appears, its tip glowing with data
He equips it, feeling a surge of *power* in his veins
A bandit NPC appears, shouting *"ATTACK!"*
Jin swings, the spear emitting a bright *critical* hit
The bandit collapses, code fragments *scattering* everywhere
A message reads *"YOU HAVE ELIMINATED ENEMY"*
Jin feels a brief rush of triumph, then *emptiness*
The tutorial quest updates: *"PART 2 COMPLETE"*
A new prompt asks, *"DO YOU WANT TO CONTINUE?"*
Jin hesitates, *remembering* his failed logout attempts
He types "YES" *hoping* for a clue
The system flashes a warning: *"MANUAL IS FAULTY"*
A hidden menu opens, showing *"LEVEL 10"*
His stats *increase*, but the exit remains locked
Jin hears a distant voice, *"HELP ME"*, distorted
He follows the sound, *entering* a dark virtual cave
Inside, a *mysterious* figure cloaked in code appears
The figure smiles, revealing a *jade* emblem on its chest
"I am the *system* itself," it whispers
Jin asks why he cannot leave this *digital* prison
The system replies, *"Your destiny is bound to this world"*
Jin feels his will *slipping*, his thoughts merging with code
He remembers his family's *shame* and his own failures
A flash of his old hunter badge *appears* in his mind
He decides to fight the system, not *surrender*
Jin channels the keenspear’s energy into a *hack*
The code *trembles*, cracks appear in the virtual walls
A portal flickers open, *promising* an unknown exit
Just as he reaches for it, the system screams *"ERROR"*
